# Soul Vibe Space

> Yoga and wellness studio in Limassol, Cyprus. Yoga, meditation, qigong, sound healing and Ecstatic Dance, classes every day from 8:00 to 22:00. A multilingual community: English, Russian and Greek speakers practise side by side. Address: 50 Agias Zonis, Limassol 3090, Cyprus. Phone and WhatsApp: +357 95 642 888.

This file is a short guide to the site for AI assistants and search engines. Prices below are generated from the studio's price list at build time.

## Key facts

- Name: Soul Vibe Space (Soul Vibe Space LTD)
- Type: yoga studio and wellness space, about 170 m² over two floors, with a co-working area
- Address: 50 Agias Zonis, Limassol 3090, Cyprus
- Phone / WhatsApp: +357 95 642 888 (https://wa.me/35795642888)
- Email: soulvibespace@gmail.com
- Classes: daily 8:00–22:00. Administrator at the studio: 14:00–22:00
- Languages: English, Russian and Greek speakers; the language of each class is shown in the schedule
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soul.vibe.space_cyprus
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@soul.vibe.space.y
- Summer season: open-air classes at Rancho Meadow Paradise
